{
  "candidate_rtl": "`timescale 1ns / 1ps
module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0,
    parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1,
    parameter W = 2**LEVELS
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

generate
if (WIDTH == 256 && !LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast256
    wire [15:0] group_valid;
    wire [15:0] group_enable;
    wire [15:0] group_selected;
    wire [255:0] local_winner;
    wire [15:0] low_terms [3:0];
    wire [15:0] high_terms [3:0];
    genvar g, j, b;
    for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        assign group_valid[g] = |input_unencoded[16*g +: 16];
        if (g == 15) begin : top_group
            assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
        end else begin : other_group
            assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
        end
        assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];
        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : positions
            if (j == 15) begin : top_position
                assign local_winner[16*g+j] = input_unencoded[16*g+j];
            end else begin : other_position
                assign local_winner[16*g+j] = input_unencoded[16*g+j] & ~(|input_unencoded[16*g+15:16*g+j+1]);
            end
            if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_position
                assign output_unencoded[0] = (local_winner[0] & group_enable[0]) | ~output_valid;
            end else begin : normal_position
                assign output_unencoded[16*g+j] = local_winner[16*g+j] & group_enable[g];
            end
        end
        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_local
            wire [15:0] masked;
            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : terms
                if ((j & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included
                    assign masked[j] = local_winner[16*g+j];
                end else begin : excluded
                    assign masked[j] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
            assign low_terms[b][g] = (|masked) & group_enable[g];
            if ((g & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included_group
                assign high_terms[b][g] = group_selected[g];
            end else begin : excluded_group
                assign high_terms[b][g] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
    for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encode_output
        assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
        assign output_encoded[b+4] = |high_terms[b];
    end
    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
end else begin : generic_tree
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : pairs
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : msb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : nodes
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline resolves the encoded index through a priority mux tree and then decodes that index into 256 output bits. The reported critical paths include high-fanout internal control and the final decode, reaching 2.60 ns.",
  "rewrite": "For the specified configuration, partition inputs into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local highest-priority one-hot winners and group suffix exclusion in parallel. Drive output_unencoded directly from local winners qualified by group exclusion, bypassing the encode/decode round trip. Compute the binary index using parallel masked reductions. Retain the reference tree for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing the serial priority-mux-to-wide-decoder path. A reasonable unverified target is approximately 1.8–2.3 ns versus the measured 2.60 ns baseline. Actual gain requires the specified mapping, STA, and electrical-check flow; no candidate measurements are available.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel local suffix reductions and separate encoded-output reduction logic, while eliminating the 256-way binary-index decoder in the optimized branch. Intended to fit the 8862.124480 um2 cap, but mapped area and buffering overhead are unverified. No state, latency, memories, or helper modules are introduced.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=256 and MSB priority, every nonzero input produces the highest set-bit index and its one-hot mask. An all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=1, matching the reference rather than suppressing the default one-hot output. Ports and unsigned declarations are preserved. The generic branch retains the reference parameter-dependent padding, priority, truncation, and default behavior, including LEVELS and W overrides. Source and mapped equivalence and implementation checks remain necessary."
}
